thread:
Priya: Kicking off the tenant_flags backfill on prod-staging now. Plan: add col, backfill in waves of 1k tenants, throttle to 200 qps, 45m rollout window. I'll monitor locks and pause between waves. @Sam @Miguel please ack for canary and pinning.

deploy-bot: Job 7890 scheduled: tenant_flags-backfill:v1 -> prod-staging. Wave 1 starting. Logs: https://ci/reports/7890

Sam: Ack. Quick ask — can we pin frontend to v3.2.1 while the backfill runs? Last deploy had a transient read-logic change that could hit the new column.

Miguel: +1 to pin. I can push a kube patch; how long is the rollback window if things go sideways?

Priya: Rollback window = 30m after wave start, but we have a 45m total rollout. Plan is to pause after wave 1 and check metrics.

deploy-bot: Wave 1 completed (1000 tenants). Duration 6m. Next wave starting in 3m.

observability-bot: ALERT: write-locks on primary increased 3.2x during wave 1. Top offender: UPDATE tenants SET tenant_flags = ... (backfill job). Sample:
```sql
UPDATE tenants SET tenant_flags = computed_flags WHERE id BETWEEN 1001 AND 2000;
```
Sessions waiting: 42, avg lock wait 1.8s.

Alice: Seeing tail latency spike in sessions API correlating to the backfill window - errors at ~0.5% for 60s. Not huge but above threshold. :eyes:

Priya: Pausing further waves. Do not start wave 2.

Sam: Pinning frontend now to v3.2.1 (deployment/frontend -> image: frontend:v3.2.1). Command run:
```bash
kubectl set image deploy/frontend frontend=registry/frontend:v3.2.1 -n prod
```
Pin applied, rollout paused for stability.

Miguel: Canceling the active job and collecting logs. deploy-bot, please cancel job 7890 and snapshot current progress.

deploy-bot: Cancel command received. Cancelling job 7890. Snapshotting progress -> s3://backfill-snapshots/7890-1730005555.tar.gz

Priya: Decision: abort this backfill iteration. We'll change strategy: smaller wave size (250 tenants), rate-limit per connection, and use a background worker to reduce lock footprint. No customer-visible schema change yet.

Alice: Recommend we also add a DB-side statement_timeout guard for the background backfill worker and a soft-lock fallback.

Sam: Agree. Also adding a release note bullet so PM/CS can mention it in the morning digest: "tenant_flags backfill postponed; no user-facing impact; follow-up rolling backfill scheduled."

Miguel: I'll open an RFC for the backfill approach and schedule the next attempt in a quieter window (Tue 02:00 UTC). Will include experiments from staging with 250 wave size.

Priya: Thanks. Action items: Miguel -> RFC + schedule; Sam -> release note entry; Alice -> statement_timeout + soft-lock runbook; Me -> update runbook and re-run tests. Reopen thread when we have the RFC. :white_check_mark:
